benchmark_context.acceptance_rule: balanced accuracy gain >= 0.02, positive MCC, macro-F1 no worse than strongest baseline
benchmark_context.test_warning: 2025 results were inspected during subsequent design review; new choices are selected from development evidence only.

manual_override.reason: User-approved activation before the required 100 matured prospective shadow observations; retain failed acceptance evidence for transparent research use.

selection_policy.notes: Every profile is staged. Hyperparameters are selected only inside purged 2015-2024 development folds; the frozen 2025 retrospective set is evaluated once after selection. Only an accepted official run with prospective shadow evidence can be promoted explicitly.
selection_policy.parameter_search: bounded deterministic development-only search per candidate, then fixed-manifest seed panel
